587df0f0.text: Ner'zhul cast a plague of undeath - which had originated from deep within the Frozen Throne, out into the arctic wasteland. Controlling the plague with his will alone, he drove it straight into the $r village. Within three days, everyone in the settlement was dead, but shortly thereafter, the dead villagers began to rise as zombified corpses. Ner'zhul could feel their individual spirits and thoughts as if they were his own.
587df0f0.title: Icecrown and the Frozen Throne

83fa4abd.text: As the Lich King mastered his growing abilities under the dreadlords' persistent vigil, he discovered a remote $r settlement on the fringe of the vast Dragonblight. On a whim, Ner'zhul decided to test his powers on the unsuspecting humans.
83fa4abd.title: Icecrown and the Frozen Throne

a325c17d.text: Over the following months, Ner'zhul continued to experiment with his plague of undeath by subjugating every $r inhabitant of Northrend. With his army of undead growing daily, he knew that the time for his true test was nearing.
a325c17d.title: Icecrown and the Frozen Throne
